answer:
On the night in Chapter 11, Sitaram stood in the way as a guard at the gate of the inner palace, on the side of the “obstacle” blocking Udayaditya’s path. But out of gratitude for the two times the prince had saved his life, he could not oppose him; he chose to lay down his weapon and be bound, remaining passive as Udayaditya forced his way past him and escaped.

On the night in Chapter 29, their roles are reversed. This time, Sitaram becomes the active rescuer: he breaks into the prison, rouses Udayaditya himself, and carries him out as though supporting him. It is Sitaram who leads the imprisoned, passive Udayaditya and even tells him where to go; Udayaditya, in turn, becomes the one who follows him, asking, “What should I do? Where should I go?”

In other words, Sitaram, who once stood in the way of the one trying to get through and ultimately remained passive, bound and opening the way, now acts on his own initiative to rescue the prince. Conversely, Udayaditya, who once actively forced his way through, now becomes a passive rescuee, simply following Sitaram’s lead.
answer_ja:
第11章の夜、シタラムは奥御殿の門を守る衛兵として立ちはだかり、ウダヤディティヤの行く手を阻む「障害」の側にいた。しかし彼はかつて王太子に二度命を救われた恩から刃向かうことができず、自ら武器を捨てて縛られることを望み、受け身のままウダヤディティヤに力ずくで突破されて脱出を許す存在だった。

第29章の夜には立場が逆転する。今度はシタラムが能動的な救出者となり、牢獄に押し入って自らウダヤディティヤを引き起こし、抱えるようにして外へ連れ出す。閉じ込められ受け身だったウダヤディティヤを導き、行き先すら指示するのはシタラムであり、ウダヤディティヤの方が「どうすればいい、どこへ行けばいい」と彼に従う側になっている。

つまり、かつて進む者を阻み、最後は縛られて道を開けた受動的なシタラムが、今度は自ら行動して王太子を助け出す能動的な救出者となり、逆にかつて力ずくで道を切り開いた能動的なウダヤディティヤが、今度はシタラムに導かれるがままの受動的な被救出者になっている。

answer:
The initial failed assassination plan was to have Pratapaditya order two Pathans (Khan Saheb and his brother) to kill Basanta Ray near the Simultali rest house while he was on his way to Jessore. The Pathan brother lured Basanta Ray’s attendants away with the false claim that “bandits have appeared in the village,” while Khan Saheb himself stayed by Basanta Ray’s palanquin at the roadside, entertaining the old king by playing the sitar and singing to him, and putting him off his guard. But when Udayaditya arrived, Khan Saheb encountered him and, out of remorse, confessed the truth, revealing that they had refrained from carrying out the assassination even in defiance of the king’s orders. Thus, the first plan ended without being carried out.

Ultimately, Pratapaditya sent the commander Mukhtiyar Khan to the fort at Raigarh with a written order. Mukhtiyar Khan first captured Udayaditya in the field and had him detained; then he had his soldiers change into plain clothes and secretly enter the fort through separate gates. He went to Basanta Ray after he had finished his prayers and showed him the execution order written in Pratapaditya’s own hand. Without even being allowed to see his nephew once, Basanta Ray entrusted Mukhtiyar with a message for his nephew and the truth that Udayaditya was innocent. He then prayed to God, accepted his death, and was cut down with a sword by Abdul, one of Mukhtiyar’s men.
answer_ja:
最初の失敗した暗殺計画は、プラタパディティヤが二人のパターン人(カーン・サーヘブとその兄)に命じ、バサンタ・ライがジョソールへ向かう途中シムルタリの宿場付近で彼を殺害させようとしたものだった。パターン人の兄はバサンタ・ライの従者たちを「村に盗賊が出た」と偽って引き離し、カーン・サーヘブ自身は道端でバサンタ・ライの輿のそばに残り、シタールを弾き歌を聴かせて老王を歓待し油断させた。しかし駆けつけたウダヤディティヤに出くわすと、カーン・サーヘブは良心の呵責から真相を告白し、自分たちは王の命令に背いてまで暗殺を思いとどまったことを明かした。こうして最初の計画は実行されずに終わった。

最終的にプラタパディティヤは、武将ムクティヤール・カーンに命令書を持たせ、ライガルの砦へ送り込んだ。ムクティヤール・カーンはまず野原でウダヤディティヤを捕らえて拘束し、その後、兵士たちを平服に着替えさせて別々の門からひそかに砦内に潜入させた。彼は祈りを終えたバサンタ・ライのもとへ赴き、プラタパディティヤ自筆の処刑命令書を見せた。バサンタ・ライは甥に一目会うことも許されぬまま、ムクティヤールに甥への伝言とウダヤディティヤの無実を託した後、神に祈りを捧げて死を受け入れ、ムクティヤールの部下アブドゥルによって剣で斬殺された。

answer: The incident in the inner quarters of the Jessore palace, where his disguise as an old woman was seen through and he was bound with his own shawl and carried out, and the incident in Ramachandra Rai’s palace, where he was dressed as a woman and present, and was thrown out of the room by the scruff of his neck for insulting Bibha.
answer_ja: ジョソール宮殿の奥御殿で老婆に変装していたところを正体を見破られ、肩のショールで縛り上げられて担ぎ出された一件と、ラーマチャンドラ・ライの王宮で女装して居合わせ、ビバを侮辱したところを首根っこを掴んで部屋から放り出された一件。

answer: Surma drank poison and killed herself.
answer_ja: スルマが自ら毒を飲み、自害したこと。

answer: Because Vibha refused Rammohan’s first attempt to escort her and stayed with her brother, Rammohan returned to Chandradwip alone, having lost face. When King Ramachandra Rai was told that “Vibha said she didn’t want to come,” he felt deeply insulted and flew into a rage. Seeking revenge, he took up his courtiers’ frivolous suggestion and decided to marry another woman. As a result, by the time Vibha changed her mind and set out for the king, it was already too late. On the day of the king’s wedding, she arrived at the palace only to be told that she had lost both her place and her home; overcome with despair, she fainted and collapsed.
answer_ja: ビバがラムモハンの最初の迎えを断り兄の元に留まったことで、ラムモハンは面目を失ったまま一人でチャンドラドウィープへ帰還した。それを「ビバが来たくないと言った」と伝えられたラーマチャンドラ・ライ王は激しい侮辱と感じて怒り狂い、仕返しのため、廷臣たちの戯言交じりの勧めに乗って別の女性と再婚することを決めてしまう。その結果、後にビバが思い直して王のもとへ向かった時にはすでに手遅れで、王の結婚式の当日に王宮へたどり着いたビバは、自分の居場所も家も失われたことを知らされ、絶望のあまり気を失って倒れるという悲劇に至る。

answer: Rukmini received the ring from Udayaditya and used the prince’s seal engraved on it to create a false petition, making it seem as though he had accused his father, Pratapaditya, of treason against the emperor and was trying to seize the throne for himself. Bhagavata presented the petition to Pratapaditya, falsely claiming that one of Udayaditya’s servants had been trying to take it out of the country. His father was enraged and, after deliberating, treated it as evidence and ordered Udayaditya’s imprisonment.
answer_ja: ルクミニーがウダヤディティヤから指輪を受け取り、それに刻まれた王太子の印章を使って、彼が父プラタパディティヤを皇帝への反逆罪で告発し、自ら王位を奪おうとしているかのような偽の嘆願書を作成した。バーガヴァタがその嘆願書を、ウダヤディティヤの家来が国外へ持ち出そうとしていたと偽ってプラタパディティヤに差し出したため、父は激怒し、熟考の末、証拠と見なしてウダヤディティヤを投獄するよう命じた。

answer: During Ramchandra Ray’s midnight escape, Ram Mohan helped him get away, so Ram Mohan and the guards, including Sitaram, were dismissed and held responsible. Unable to watch them struggle, Udayaditya secretly gave wages to the dismissed Sitaram and Bhagavata, while Surma also sent money through a maid to Sitaram’s mother and Bhagavata’s wife. This secret aid eventually reached Pratapaditya’s ears. Furious, he ordered Surma to return to her parental home.
answer_ja: ラーマチャンドラ・ライの真夜中の脱出では、ラムモハンが手引きして逃がしたため、その責任を問われたラムモハンとシタラムら衛兵が解雇された。ウダヤディティヤはその困窮を見かね、解雇されたシタラムとバーガヴァタに内密に俸給を与え、スルマも侍女を通じてシタラムの母やバーガヴァタの妻に金を届けさせた。この秘密の援助がやがてプラタパディティヤの耳に入り、彼は激怒し、スルマに実家へ帰るよう命じた。

answer:
## Emotional significance of the song

The song “I alone am left behind” expresses the loneliness and sense of loss of someone left behind after the people dear to them, with whom they once shared their joys, have gone. Though there is no one left to sing to, the song wells up on its own, but there is no joy in it anymore. Even when joy is felt, there is no one with whom to share it; the song is tinged with an unfulfilled emptiness.

## Two contrasting contexts

1. **While watching the setting sun and softly singing to himself amid the lively song “Tajbe Taj, Naube Naub”**: Outwardly, he acts cheerful, singing and dancing boisterously with Khan Saheb and the others, but in the pause between songs, a song of loneliness spills from deep within him, as if escaping his heart.

2. **At the royal palace in Jessore, when he realizes that no one is in Surma’s room, once so full of life**: The room where cheers once rang out whenever Granduncle came is now silent, and only Biba is there to welcome him. Confronted with this emptiness, he takes Biba’s hand and quietly sings this song.

In one context, the song is sung as loneliness lurking beneath outward merriment; in the other, it is an expression of grief in the face of the emptiness of the present reality.
answer_ja:
## 歌の感情的な意味合い

「私だけが、ただ一人残された」という歌は、かつて共に喜びを分かち合った大切な人々が去ってしまい、自分だけが取り残された孤独と喪失感を表している。歌う相手はもういないのに歌はひとりでに湧いてくるが、そこにはもはや喜びがない。喜びを感じても、それを分かち合いたいと願う相手がいないという、満たされない虚しさがにじむ歌である。

## 2つの対照的な状況

1. **陽気な歌（タージベ・タージ・ナウベ・ナウ）の最中に沈みゆく太陽を見つめながら、ふとひとり口ずさむ場面**：表向きは朗らかに振る舞い、カーン・サーヘブらと賑やかに歌い踊っていたのに、その合間に心の奥から漏れ出るように、孤独の歌がこぼれる。

2. **ジョソールの王宮で、かつて賑やかだったスルマの部屋に誰もいないことを知った場面**：以前は大おじ様が来ると歓声が上がった部屋が、今は静まり返り、ビバ一人しか迎えてくれない。その虚しさを目の当たりにして、ビバの手を取りながら静かにこの歌を歌う。

一つは表面的な賑わいの裏に潜む寂しさとして、もう一つは目の前の現実の空虚さを前にした悲しみの表出として、対照的な形でこの歌が歌われている。

answer: Rukmini realized that Udayaditya was escaping and rushed to the canal, but Sitaram stopped her and seized her. Screaming, she threw herself into the canal, and failed to stop the escape there and then. But she survived, and, still consumed by anger and a desire for revenge, returned to the palace and appealed to Pratapaditya. There, she testified plainly that Udayaditya had conspired to escape with the old king (Basanta Ray) and Sitaram, thereby revealing the truth to the king. This denunciation enraged Pratapaditya, who issued an order: “If Udayaditya cannot be found, execute Basanta Ray in his place.” Later, although Udayaditya was captured in the wilderness and identified himself, offering to take Basanta Ray’s place, Muktiyar Khan would not yield, insisting that it was the king’s explicit command. In the end, he went to Basanta Ray and carried out the execution. In other words, Rukmini’s failure to stop the escape that night—and her survival—made her denunciation possible, which directly led to Pratapaditya’s order to execute Basanta Ray.
answer_ja: ルクミニーはウダヤディティヤの逃亡を察知して運河まで駆けつけたが、シタラムに阻まれて取り押さえられ、絶叫しながら運河に身を投げてその場では逃亡を止められなかった。しかし彼女は死なずに生き延び、怒りと復讐心を抱いたまま王宮に戻ってプラタパディティヤに訴え出た。そこで彼女は、ウダヤディティヤが老王（バサンタ・ライ）とシタラムの三人で共謀して逃げたことを明確に証言し、王に真相を知らせてしまう。この密告によってプラタパディティヤは激怒し、「ウダヤディティヤが見つからなければ、代わりにバサンタ・ライを処刑せよ」という命令を発する。その後、野で捕らえられたウダヤディティヤが自ら名乗り出て身代わりを申し出たにもかかわらず、ムクティヤール・カーンは王の明確な命令だとして譲らず、結局バサンタ・ライのもとへ赴いて処刑を執行する。つまり、あの夜ルクミニーが逃亡を阻止できず生き延びたことが、彼女の密告を可能にし、それがプラタパディティヤによるバサンタ・ライ処刑命令という直接の結果を招いたのである。

answer:
During their first meeting, Pratapaditya treated his son-in-law with contempt, having no lights or musicians prepared and providing insultingly few elephants and attendants, which deeply wounded Ramchandra’s pride. At the audience, too, Pratapaditya welcomed him quietly and without showing any joy, gave precedence to matters of state, and dismissed him curtly with “Go inside,” maintaining a condescending attitude throughout. Ramchandra was made to realize then just how much greater his father-in-law was than he.

On the other hand, after returning to his own court, Ramchandra continued to nurse this humiliation and made Pratapaditya the target of mockery and slander almost every day. In league with his ministers and Ramai Bhand, he looked down on Pratapaditya’s ancestry (“His grandfather was an earthworm, and his son a leech,” and so on) and fixated on insulting his father-in-law by exploiting his own position as a son-in-law. The contrast, then, is that the humiliation of being overwhelmed and able to do no more than submit during their actual encounter is avenged in the safety of his own court through petty retaliation and bluster backed by his power.
answer_ja:
最初の対面では、プラタパディティヤが灯りも楽隊も用意させず婿を軽んじた扱いをし、象や従者の数まで侮辱的に少なく、ラーマチャンドラは激しく自尊心を傷つけられた。しかも謁見では、プラタパディティヤは婿を喜びも見せず静かに迎え、政務の話を優先し、短く「奥へ参れ」と退けるなど、終始見下す態度を取った。ラーマチャンドラはその場で、舅がいかに自分より偉大かを思い知らされた。

一方、自分の宮廷に戻ったラーマチャンドラは、この屈辱を根に持ち続け、ほぼ毎日プラタパディティヤを嘲笑と中傷の的にする。大臣やラマイ・バンドらと結託し、プラタパディティヤの出自を見下し（「祖父はミミズ、その子がヒル」など）、婿としての自分の立場を利用して舅を侮辱することに執心する。つまり、現実の対面では圧倒され従属的な態度しか取れなかった屈辱を、自らの宮廷という安全な場で、権力を笠に着た卑小な仕返し・虚勢で晴らしている点が対照的である。

answer: Rukmini, who was widowed at a young age in Raigarh, was the woman who seduced Udayaditya when he was eighteen and had a brief illicit affair with him. Later, she left Raigarh, changed her name to Mangala, and settled quietly in a corner of Jessore. Using her beauty and money to manipulate people, she continued to harbor ambitions to control the crown prince’s heart and the kingdom of Jessore, and kept in touch with palace servants to learn its secrets. Eventually, when the queen secretly asked Mangala for a potion to win back the crown prince’s heart before driving Surma away, Mangala, out of hatred, spent five days preparing poison for Surma, along with a spell. Surma drank the poison and lost her life. Later, on a stormy night, Rukmini crept into Udayaditya’s bedroom carrying a lamp, unsettled him with tearful appeals that invoked their former intimacy, snatched his ring, and left.
answer_ja: ライガルで若くして未亡人となったルクミニーは、ウダヤディティヤが十八歳の折に彼を誘惑し、短い過ちの関係を結んだ相手だった。後に彼女はライガルを去り、マンガラと名を変えてジョソールの片隅にひっそり暮らすようになる。美貌と金銭で人心を操る彼女は、王太子の心とジョソールの王国を支配する野望を燃やし続け、王宮の使用人たちと通じて内情を探っていた。やがて王妃がスルマを追い出す前に王太子の心を取り戻そうと、マンガラに密かに薬を頼んだところ、彼女は憎しみからスルマへの毒薬を五日がかりで呪術とともに調合し、それによってスルマは毒を仰いで命を落とす。その後、嵐の夜、ルクミニーは灯りを手にウダヤディティヤの寝室に忍び込み、昔の情を盾に涙ながらに訴えて彼を動揺させ、指輪を奪い取って去っていく。

answer: His lament at being born into the royal palace and made crown prince, his wish to be an ordinary person and to have no throne, wealth, or honor, finally came to fruition when, after being taken prisoner over his great-uncle’s death, he was brought before Pratapaditya. When his father told him, “You are not fit for my kingdom,” he replied without flinching, “I am not fit. I do not want your kingdom. Please release me from the throne.” Touching the feet of the goddess Kali, he swore never to rule even a single piece of land in the kingdom of Jessor, never to touch the throne or scepter, and that Samaraditya alone was the heir. Thus he formally renounced the throne as he had wished, left for Kashi, and chose to live as an ascetic.
answer_ja: 王宮に生まれ王太子であること自体を嘆き、王座も富も名誉もいらない、民の一人であったならと願っていた彼の思いは、やがて大おじの死をめぐり囚われの身となってプラタパディティヤの前に引き出された際に結実する。父に「お前は我が王国にふさわしくない」と告げられると、彼は動じることなく「私はふさわしくありません。あなたの王国は望みません。どうか王位から私を解き放ってください」と答え、カーリー女神の御足に触れて、ジョソールの王国の土地一かけらも統治せず、玉座にも王笏にも決して触れないこと、サマラディティヤこそが後継者であることを誓う。こうして望みどおり王位を正式に放棄し、カーシーへ去って修行僧として生きる道を選んだ。

answer: Ramchandra Ray wrote to Pratapaditya that he intended to divorce Vibha and sent the letter with his messenger, Nayan Chand. But Nayan Chand feared that terrible things would happen if the letter reached Pratapaditya, so he secretly handed it to the queen along the way. Without telling Vibha, the queen secretly consulted Vibha’s great-uncle, Basanta Ray, and showed him the letter. Basanta Ray naively interpreted it as “Ramchandra wrote it simply in anger, and if Vibha is sent back, his anger will subside,” and the queen agreed. So the two decided to conceal the truth of the letter and spread a false rumor throughout the household that “Ramchandra Ray sent a letter asking that Vibha be sent to her husband’s home.” As a result, Vibha came to believe that, rather than divorcing her, her husband was calling her to join him, and she felt great joy and relief.
answer_ja: ラーマチャンドラ・ライはビバを離縁する旨の手紙をプラタパディティヤ宛に書き、使者ナヤンチャンドに届けさせました。しかしナヤンチャンドはこの手紙がプラタパディティヤの手に渡れば恐ろしい事態になると恐れ、途中で王妃にこっそり渡しました。王妃はビバに知らせず、密かに大おじバサンタ・ライに相談し、手紙の内容を見せました。バサンタ・ライはこれを「ラーマチャンドラがただ腹を立てて書いただけで、ビバを送り返せば怒りは収まる」という純朴な解釈をし、王妃もそれに同調しました。そこで二人は手紙の真実を隠すことにし、屋敷中に「ラーマチャンドラ・ライがビバを嫁ぎ先に送るよう要請する手紙を寄越した」という偽の噂を流しました。その結果、ビバは離縁ではなく夫が自分を迎えに呼んでいると信じ込み、大きな喜びと安堵を感じることになりました。

answer: Pratapaditya blocked the canal channel with a large sal log, hoping to stop Ramchandra Ray’s boat and capture him. But the guards wasted time searching for a gun and tinder, while the messenger sent to fetch pursuit boats was greatly delayed by stopping at shops along the way and demanding repayment of debts, and was then thoroughly scolded. In the end, all hope of catching the boat was lost. Meanwhile, Rammohan and the others got the boat over the log and kept it moving, and Ramchandra Ray escaped safely as far as the Bhairava River, so the trap failed.
answer_ja: プラタパディティヤは運河の水路を大きな沙羅の木の丸太で塞ぎ、ラーマチャンドラ・ライの舟を足止めして捕らえようとしたが、見張り役たちは鉄砲も火口も見つからず手間取り、追跡用の舟を呼びに行った使者も途中で店に寄り道したり借金の催促をしたりして大幅に遅れた挙句、散々叱責されるばかりで、結局舟を捕まえる見込みは完全に失われてしまった。その間にラムモハンたちは丸太を乗り越えて舟を進め、ラーマチャンドラ・ライは無事にバイラヴァ川まで逃げおおせたため、罠は失敗に終わった。

answer:
Basanta Ray’s sitar symbolizes the very bond between him and Udayaditya. In the parting scene, when he has to leave Udayaditya, he strums the sitar furiously in his grief, but soon can barely play through his tears. At last, he stops and says, “I will never play the sitar again,” leaving it at Udayaditya’s house. By giving up what had been a source of music and joy for him, he shows that he is prepared to lose the joy in life itself.

Later, when Udayaditya is imprisoned, Basanta Ray sings of his loneliness at being left alone, while saying that the sitar is “here,” but “its strings have snapped, and it can no longer be tuned.” Though the sitar is still with him, its broken, unplayable state reflects how his own heart has been broken by the loss of his bonds with those he loves, leaving him unable to regain comfort or joy. In short, the sitar’s silence symbolically conveys his profound despair over the cruel fate surrounding Udayaditya and his loss of the joy of living.
answer_ja:
バサンタ・ライのシタールは、彼とウダヤディティヤとの絆そのものを象徴している。ウダヤディティヤのもとを去らねばならなくなった別れの場面で、彼は悲しみのあまりシタールを激しく掻き鳴らすが、涙で演奏すらままならなくなり、ついには弾くのをやめ、「もうシタールは弾かん」と言ってそれをウダヤディティヤの家に置いていく。これは、彼にとって音楽と喜びの源であったものを手放すことで、自らの人生の喜びそのものを失うという覚悟を示している。

その後、ウダヤディティヤが投獄されるという事態に至り、バサンタ・ライは一人残された寂しさを歌う一方で、シタールは「ある」が「弦が切れてしまって、もう音を合わせることができぬ」と語る。シタール自体は手元にあっても、弾くことのできない壊れた状態にあるという描写は、彼の心そのものが、愛する者たちとの絆を失ったことで壊れ、もはや癒やしや喜びを取り戻せない状態にあることを映し出している。つまり、シタールの沈黙は、ウダヤディティヤを取り巻く過酷な運命に対する彼の深い絶望と、生きる喜びの喪失を象徴的に表しているのである。

answer: Earlier, Udayaditya was known as a courageous man who risked his life to stand up against tyranny on behalf of the oppressed, heedless of danger. He actively intervened in the people’s affairs, even going so far as to defy his father, the king. But after Surma’s death, an inexplicable, blind fear of Pratapaditya took root in his heart, and he lost the courage he had once possessed. Even when he saw a subject being beaten by an official and crying out for help, he no longer tried to stop it and rescue them as he once would have; unable to bear the sight of their suffering, he fled inside the building. He had become passive and powerless, hesitating and doubting himself in everything.
answer_ja: 以前のウダヤディティヤは、危険を顧みず、暴政に対して命がけで虐げられた民のために立ち向かう勇気ある人物として知られ、実際に民の仕事に加わっては父王に逆らうほど積極的に介入していた。しかしスルマの死後、彼の心にはプラタパディティヤへの得体の知れない盲目的な恐怖が芽生え、かつての勇気を失ってしまう。民が目の前で役人に打たれ助けを求めても、以前のように制止して救おうとはせず、その苦痛に耐えきれず建物の中へ逃げ込んでしまうなど、何事にも躊躇し疑念を抱く、消極的で無力な姿へと変わり果てた。

answer: Sitaram had helped with Bhagavat's false petition, thereby causing Crown Prince Udayaditya to be imprisoned. In the end, he made amends for the harm he had caused by setting fire to the prison, rescuing the prince, and taking him outside.
answer_ja: シタラムは、バーガヴァタの偽の嘆願書の件に協力し、その結果ウダヤディティヤ王太子が投獄される原因を作ってしまったが、最終的には牢獄に火をつけて王太子を救い出し、外へ連れ出すことで、自らが引き起こした被害を取り返した。

answer: On the first occasion, he tied Ramchandra Rai to his own back, descended seventy cubits from the rooftop along a cloth rope stretched from the palace to the canal, and carried him to the boat waiting there to help him escape. On the second, he lifted Bibha himself after she fainted and fell from the insult of Ramai Bhand, put her in one of the palanquins at the doorway, and carried her straight to the boat, taking her out of the palace.
answer_ja: 一度目は、ラーマチャンドラ・ライを自分の背中に縛りつけ、城から運河まで渡した布製の綱を伝って屋上から七十ハットの高さを降り、待たせていた船まで運んで脱出させた。二度目は、ラマイ・バンドの侮辱で気を失って倒れたビバを自ら抱き起こし、戸口にあった駕籠の一つに乗せて、そのまま船へと運んで宮殿から連れ出した。

answer:
While preparing in Jessore, Vibha was made to wear eight thick gold bangles, enormous diamond armlets, and a large nose ornament that did not suit her. With her hair pinned up, she was dressed in dazzling finery. Her face shone with irrepressible joy; she was a bride at the height of happiness, blessed and cherished by those around her.

By contrast, when she went to see him in Chandradwip, Vibha changed into the simple clothes of an ordinary woman and walked there like a beggar, without even riding in a palanquin. Her veil had slipped off, and at the palace she was treated like any other maid or servant; no one welcomed her with respect. Stripped of all her former finery, she had become a forsaken, pitiful figure who, in despair and humiliation, threw herself at the king’s feet.
answer_ja:
ジョソールでの準備の際、ビバは王妃に太い金の腕輪八本や巨大なダイヤモンドの腕飾り、似合わない大きな鼻飾りを着けさせられ、結い上げた髪など豪華絢爛に着飾らせられていた。抑えきれない喜びに顔を輝かせ、周囲の者たちから祝福され愛でられる、幸福の絶頂にある花嫁の姿だった。

一方チャンドラドウィープで訪ねた時には、ビバは質素な一般女性の身なりに着替え、輿にも乗らず物乞いの女のように徒歩で向かった。ヴェールは脱げ落ち、宮殿では他の下女や召使と同様に扱われ、誰からも丁重に迎えられることはなかった。かつての華やかな装飾品は一切なく、絶望と恥辱の中で王の足元に身を投げ出す、見捨てられた哀れな姿へと変わり果てていた。

answer:
In the bedchamber after Surma’s death, the window was a mirror reflecting Surma’s absence. It was where Surma used to sit, and even with the same moonlight, the same garden, and the same breeze before him, the person who should have been there was no longer there. For Udayaditya, the window had become a place that stirred up grief and memories, and a futile hope of being reunited with her.

In the prison, by contrast, the window becomes a symbol of hope and freedom. Because he can gaze at the sky and the birds through it, he can continue to believe that he will one day be free. When he moves away from the window, everything around him sinks into darkness, and he feels as though he might forget the day of his release. But as long as he stays close to the window, he can feel that he is inherently free and possesses a soul no powerful ruler can imprison. The bed in his once-comfortable bedchamber was the true prison, while the window in this small prison became a place that reminded him of the freedom he was born with.

In short, the window changes from “a symbol of loss that reminds him of what he has lost” to “a symbol of hope that reminds him of a freedom he has not lost.”
answer_ja:
スルマの死後の寝室では、窓はスルマの不在を映す鏡だった。窓辺はスルマが座っていた場所であり、同じ月明かり・同じ庭園・同じ風を前にしても、そこにいるべき人はもういない。窓はウダヤディティヤにとって喪失と記憶、叶わぬ再会への虚しい期待を呼び起こす場となっていた。

一方、牢獄の窓は希望と自由の象徴へと変わる。空と鳥を眺められるこの窓があるからこそ、彼はいつか自由になれると信じ続けられる。窓から離れれば周囲は暗闇に沈み、解放の日を忘れそうになるが、窓に寄り添っている限り、自分は本来自由な存在であり、どんな権力者にも囚われない魂を持つのだと実感できる。かつて安楽だった寝室の寝具こそが真の牢獄であり、この小さな牢の窓こそが生まれながらの自由を思い出させてくれる場所になった。

つまり、窓は「失われたものを思い出させる喪失の象徴」から「失われていない自由を思い出させる希望の象徴」へと変化している。

answer:
Sitaram and Rukmini (Mangala) had a purely self-interested relationship at first. Whenever he was short of money, Sitaram, who liked to pose as a dandy, would visit Rukmini, who used her beauty and money to manipulate people. He would woo her with sweet words, pile up debts, and conveniently forget to repay them. Rukmini, too, did not truly love Sitaram; theirs was a relationship of banter in which they each took advantage of their financial dealings and flirtation.

But when Udayaditya was imprisoned, Sitaram tried to enlist Rukmini’s help in his escape plan, while at the same time violently berating and threatening her. When he went so far as to declare, “I’ll set fire to your house, smear your face with ashes, and drive you out of town,” the resentment that had built up inside Rukmini exploded. She declared, “The Crown Prince is mine,” and vowed revenge.

Sitaram then set a fire and staged a cover-up, involving Rukmini as well, to conceal the Crown Prince’s escape—and tried to leave her to die. When he later met Rukmini again, soaked and half-mad, Sitaram attempted a perfunctory reconciliation, but she took up a kitchen knife and genuinely tried to cut his throat. He barely escaped with his life. In the end, out of resentment at his betrayal, Rukmini exposed to the king the entire conspiracy involving Sitaram, the old king, and the Crown Prince. Their relationship, which had begun with money and flirtation, had completely degenerated into hatred and a destructive conflict in which each sought the other’s life.
answer_ja:
シタラムとルクミニー（マンガラ）の関係は、はじめは完全に打算的なものでした。金に困るたびに洒落者を気取るシタラムは、美貌と金で人を操るルクミニーのもとへ通い、彼女を甘い言葉で口説いては借金を重ね、返済のことは都合よく忘れてしまいます。ルクミニーもまた、シタラムを本気で愛しているわけではなく、金銭のやり取りと戯れを互いに利用し合う、軽口の応酬のような間柄でした。

ところが、ウダヤディティヤが投獄されると、シタラムはその逃亡計画にルクミニーの力を借りようとし、同時に彼女を激しく罵倒して脅しつけます。「お前の家に火をつけ、顔に灰を塗って町から追い出してやる」とまで言い放ったことで、ルクミニーの中に蓄積していた恨みが爆発し、彼女は「王太子は自分のものだ」と言い放ち、復讐を誓います。

さらにシタラムは王太子の逃亡を隠すため、ルクミニーも巻き込んだ放火と偽装工作を行い、彼女を見殺しにしようとします。濡れて半狂乱になったルクミニーと再会したシタラムは、形だけの仲直りを試みますが、彼女は包丁を手に本気で彼の首をはねようとし、シタラムは命からがら逃げ出します。最終的にルクミニーは、裏切られた恨みから王の前でシタラムと老王、王太子の陰謀をすべて暴露し、金と戯れで始まった関係は、互いの命を狙い合うほどの憎悪と破滅的な対立へと変わり果てました。

answer: Sitaram’s original purpose in setting fire to the guardhouse was simply to keep the guards occupied there while he secretly led Udayaditya out of prison. But as the commotion over the fire continued, Sitaram and his companions layered on further stratagems. First, while pretending to extinguish the fire, they poured water where there were no flames and broke water jars, obstructing the firefighting itself and ensuring the fire would not go out. Then they set fire to Udayaditya’s now-empty prison cell, igniting the windows, doors, beams, railings, and other parts one after another until the room was ablaze. They also threw bones, a skull, and Udayaditya’s sword into the burning room, fabricating physical evidence to make it seem as though he had burned to death inside. When the guards noticed something amiss at the prison, Sitaram himself directed them by shouting, “The roof of the prince’s room has collapsed, and no one can be heard anymore,” creating a situation in which no one could enter the fire to check. Finally, by having the remains of the melted sword recovered and presented as evidence, he spread the rumor that the prince had burned to death, turning the guardhouse fire from a mere distraction into a cover-up that completely concealed Udayaditya’s escape.
answer_ja: シタラムが衛兵詰所に放火した当初の目的は、衛兵たちをそちらへ釘付けにし、ウダヤディティヤを牢獄からこっそり連れ出すための単なる目くらましだった。しかし火事の騒ぎが続く中、シタラムとその仲間たちはさらに計略を重ねていく。まず消火を装いながら、火のない場所に水をかけたり水瓶を割ったりして消火活動そのものを妨害し、火が消えないよう仕向けた。そのうえで、すでにもぬけの殻となったウダヤディティヤの牢獄に新たに火を放ち、窓や扉、梁、柵などに次々と火をつけて燃え上がらせた。さらに、骨や頭蓋骨、そしてウダヤディティヤの剣をその燃える部屋の中に投げ込み、あたかも彼がその中で焼死したかのような物的証拠を偽装した。衛兵たちが牢獄の異変に気づくと、シタラムは「王太子の部屋の屋根が崩れ落ち、もう声は聞こえない」と自ら叫んで人々を誘導し、誰も火の中に踏み込んで確認できない状況を作り出した。最後に溶けた剣の残骸を回収させて証拠として提示させることで、王太子が焼死したという噂を広め、衛兵詰所の火事という目くらましを、ウダヤディティヤの逃亡そのものを完全に闇に葬る偽装工作へと発展させたのである。

answer: Ramchandra Ray showed no gratitude at all for Udayaditya risking his own safety to save his life. Instead, he continued to make his brother-in-law the subject of jokes and ridicule in court. He interpreted the rescue as “an attempt to help Bibhā, not as an end in itself to save his life,” and, because Udayaditya was Pratapaditya’s son, casually brought up his name and joined the courtiers in making fun of him. He also thought it was only natural that everyone would help him if he were in danger, and did not regard it as a debt of gratitude.
answer_ja: ラーマチャンドラ・ライは、ウダヤディティヤが自らの危険を顧みず自分の命を救ってくれたことを少しも感謝せず、むしろ宮廷では彼を冗談やからかいの種にし続けた。彼はその救出を「ビバのために自分を助けたのであり、自分の命を救うこと自体が目的ではなかった」と解釈し、またウダヤディティヤがプラタパディティヤの息子であることを理由に、平然とその名を持ち出しては廷臣たちと共に笑いものにした。自分が危機に陥れば皆が助けるのは当然だとも考えており、恩義として受け止めることはなかった。

answer:
The Emperor of Delhi (Dillīśvara) was initially dismissed as someone who need not be feared. When a minister raised him as a concern as Pratapaditya was about to carry out the assassination of his uncle Basanta Rai, Pratapaditya brushed him aside, saying, “Dillīśvara is not my god” and “Anyone has the right to be angry.”

Later, however, in order to bring down Crown Prince Udayaditya, Bhagavata and Sitaram forged a false petition claiming that the prince intended to accuse his father, Pratapaditya, of treason before the Emperor of Delhi and seize the throne for himself. They used the prince’s signet ring, which they had obtained from Rukmini. Bhagavata made a show of sending the petition to Delhi, but actually brought it to Pratapaditya himself, presenting it as something a retainer had found while fleeing the country. After reading it, Pratapaditya came to use the very charge of treason against the Emperor of Delhi that he had once treated lightly as grounds for imprisoning his own son, Udayaditya.
answer_ja:
デリー皇帝（ディリーシュワル)は当初、プラタパディティヤが叔父バサンタ・ライ暗殺を決行するにあたり大臣が懸念材料として持ち出した際、プラタパディティヤ自身が「ディリーシュワルは私の神ではない」「怒る権利など誰にでもある」と一蹴し、恐れる必要のない存在として退けていた。

ところがその後、バーガヴァタとシタラムが王太子ウダヤディティヤを陥れるため、王太子がデリー皇帝に父プラタパディティヤを反逆罪で告発し自ら王位を得ようとしているという偽の嘆願書を、ルクミニーから手に入れた王太子の印章入り指輪を使って偽造した。バーガヴァタはこの嘆願書をデリーへ送る体裁をとりつつ、実際にはプラタパディティヤ自身の元へ持参し、家来が国外逃亡の途中で発見した体で差し出した。これを読んだプラタパディティヤは、かつて軽く扱っていたはずのデリー皇帝への反逆という名目そのものを、実の息子ウダヤディティヤを投獄する根拠として用いることになった。

answer: Vibha loved Surma so much that she would secretly let her do her hair; Surma alone understood what hairstyle suited her. Even when the queen redid it, Vibha found Surma’s way of styling her hair more comforting than anything else. Later, after Surma disappeared, whenever it was time to have her hair done, Vibha would sit quietly, as if waiting for Surma to appear at any moment and do it for her. But no one came, and her hair grew disheveled, uncombed. That disheveled hair told of how there was no longer anyone to care for her and make her look beautiful; before long, others too saw her as a pitiful figure, sunk in sorrow and with no one to look after her.
answer_ja: ビバはスルマにこっそり髪を結ってもらうほどスルマを慕い、スルマだけが自分に似合う髪型を分かってくれる存在だった。王妃に結い直されても、ビバはスルマの結い方を何より心地よく感じていた。その後スルマが姿を消すと、髪を結う時間が来るたびにビバは、まるで今にもスルマが現れて髪を結ってくれるのを待つかのように黙って座り込む。しかし誰も来ず、髪は結われぬまま乱れていく。その乱れた髪は、もはや彼女を気遣い美しく整えてくれる人がいなくなったことを物語り、やがて人の目にも、悲しみに沈み世話をする者もいない哀れな姿として映るようになる。
